profile.summary: Scientist specializing in Computer Science and Cell Biology & Genetics. Interests in software engineering, equitable education, and medicine + healthcare. Knowledgeable in building 0-1 projects, executing multi-quarter migrations, bridging technical limitations with product requirements, and delivering impact with a bias for action. Additional experience in leadership, mentoring, facilitation, and activity/curriculum planning.

positions.description:
Infrastructure - User Billing Integrations
- High performing engineer promoted twice within 3 years, with consecutive exceeds and greatly exceeds designation in performance
- Maintained and improved platform that allows Stripe to price, bill, and invoice all their products (25+ billion records per month)

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Undergraduate Teaching Assistant for upper level Computer Science course on Programming Technologies and Paradigms (revolves around concurrency, multithreading, type systems, etc)
- Hosted office hours 3hrs/wk both online and in-person, assisting students through HWs and coding projects and honing their debugging and critical thinking skills 
- Monitored and answered student questions and concerns on Piazza daily

positions.title: Undergraduate Computer Science Peer Advisor
positions.description:
- Peer Advisor for the Undergraduate Computer Science Advising Office 
- Acted as first point of contact for undergraduate students during drop-in advising 
- Promptly and accurately responded to emails, phone calls, and voicemails from student and parent inquires regarding the Computer Science track
- Maintained and updated Undergraduate Computer Science blog, posting job, scholarship, and research opportunities for students

positions.title: Terps for Change Coordinator
positions.description:
- Created and facilitated activity plans for weekly dialogues that invoked discussion, reflection, and service learning
- Supervised eighteen volunteers at a community service site weekly
- Engaged in weekly discussions to develop leadership skills, collaborate with fellow coordinators, and polish a growth mindset

positions.title: Coordinator Support and Education Intern
positions.description:
- Interned for a service-learning organization that encompasses approximately thirty coordinators and one hundred participants 
- Designed and facilitated weekly dialogues adapted to a virtual setting for coordinators that focus on various social issues/identities and encourage thoughtful discussion (24 topics/dialogues total) 
- Mentored and guided half (fifteen) of the organization’s coordinators, providing them feedback and recommendations on team building, leadership, and activity planning
- Authored a new returner track dialogue for participants, outlining curriculum and activities for each of the eight sessions and mentoring coordinators through the facilitation process

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Interned for the iOS Credit Card payments team for the Capital One mobile app 
- Engineered iOS widgets of multiple sizes applicable for iOS14+ utilizing WidgetKit, SwiftUI, and networking tools to allow users to see relevant account information easily from their Home Screen
- Enhanced user experience of the widget by incorporating branding and an option to hide sensitive information 
- Volunteered for Capital One Coders, serving as a mentor to introduce K-12 students to Computer Science and teach them html and css through a mini website

projects.title: Analyzing US Fatal Shootings - CMSC320 Final Project
projects.description: This is a data science walkthrough/tutorial for a final project for an Introduction to Data Science class. Coded in python, it utilizes pandas, matplotlib, folium, and sklearn. The dataset used is Washington Post's US fatal shootings from 2015 - present. As described in their Github "The Post is documenting only those shootings in which a police officer, in the line of duty, shoots and kills a civilian — the circumstances that most closely parallel the 2014 killing of Michael Brown in Ferguson, Mo., which began the protest movement culminating in Black Lives Matter and an increased focus on police accountability nationwide. The Post is not tracking deaths of people in police custody, fatal shootings by off-duty officers or non-shooting deaths."
